doc.title: Urbie Green interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995

title: Merv Gold's mouthpiece pranks
summary: Anecdotes about trombonist Merv Gold's sure grip mouthpiece and mouthpiece necklace.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: I have a quick story I wanted to ask you. I read about a fellow named Marv Gold?
And some practical joke he did with some mouthpiece that he—

Oh, yeah, well he was always doing, you know, he had a wonderful sense of humor. But he gave me a present of this mouthpiece, a trombone mouthpiece, and said, “I want you to try this, I call it, it’s my new ‘sure grip’ mouthpiece.” And around the rim of it, it made a jagged edge all the way around, like teeth. “Sure grip” so to speak. Then another time he brought me in a necklace of mouthpieces. He’s always, you know, he could never find
a mouthpiece that he liked, so he had hundreds of them, and he made a whole necklace out of them and put it around my neck on a recording session one time.
